title: Final Height Equation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final equation for height h in terms of tau, m, g, and r.

title: Correct Numerical Value
description: Essential Criteria: The student must calculate and present the approximate numerical value of h as 1.5 km.

title: Chemical Potential Understanding
description: Important Criteria: The student should demonstrate understanding of the relationship between internal and external chemical potentials.

title: Logarithmic Manipulation
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly manipulate logarithmic expressions to derive the final height equation.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Relative Humidity Application
description: Optional Criteria: The student should correctly apply the concept of relative humidity in the context of the problem.

title: Sign Mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common sign mistakes in the equations related to chemical potentials.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should not omit any necessary factors, such as the mass of water or gravitational acceleration.
